name: Sara's Campground
note: RVs camp on the wooded bay-side sites east of Peninsula Drive, at the Presque Isle State Park entrance; the Lake Erie beach side across the road is tent-only and first come, first served. Reservations by phone or email only, no online booking. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site sarascampground.com (read 2026-10-21): 2026 rates with motorhomes/trailers $58/night, bay-side numbered sites with cement pads and full hookups 'primarily where our motor homes, trailers and pop-ups stay', phone 814-833-4560, open for the season; RV Life reviews Sep-Oct 2026 from motorhomes/travel trailers paying $58 a night; seasonal sites offered but no count anywhere and nights plainly sold -> real transient RV campground; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: Audit 2026-10-21. RV sites are the bay-side loop (OSM way 385490485, east of Peninsula Dr); the operator says the Lake Erie side is tent-only beach camping and 'we no longer allow any motorhomes/trailers on the beach'. Esri imagery at 42.1127,-80.1517 (z19, rendered): the loop's eastern arm backs onto ~50-60 m of emergent marsh (reed texture, meandering channel) before open Presque Isle Bay water, a vegetated buffer with no apron and no confirmed sightline; elsewhere the loop is wooded. Lake Erie is ~150-250 m west, behind Peninsula Dr, the Presque Isle Shores condos and a tree belt (frames at 42.1132,-80.1558 and 42.1142,-80.1552 show only beach and trees, no RV pads). Defaulted down.
fees_source: https://www.sarascampground.com/ '2026 Rates' (read 2026-10-21): Motorhomes and Trailers $58.00 per night, $348 per week; additional adults beyond the party $10/person/night (not a per-site fee). RV Life reviews Sep-Oct 2026 paid $58 for numbered sites; 'BF' sites reported at $74-85 are not on the operator's table.

booking.note: 5-night minimum on reservations May 15 - Sep 15; shorter stays by checking with the office, availability limited.

booking_source: https://www.sarascampground.com/ Reservation Information (read 2026-10-21): 'We require a 5 NIGHT MINIMUM STAY for reservations from May 15th through September 15th. If you do not meet the 5 night reservation requirement, you can check with the office for availability but availability is limited.'
flags: 5-night minimum on reservations May 15 - Sep 15 (four months of ordinary summer nights, like Alcona 3996 which was dropped). Kept because the operator says shorter stays can be had by checking with the office (AWH 2026-10-19: a minimum avoidable by calling ahead is not a drop), but availability is 'limited'; AWH may prefer to drop it.

Waterfront contradiction for a re-audit if wanted: RV Life reviews dated Sep 2026 describe lakeside RV pads ('Lighthouse' spot, '40 x 20 pad right on the lakefront'; 'BF' sites at $74-85 with views of the lake), while the operator's 2026 page says no motorhomes/trailers on the beach and the Esri imagery shows no RV pads on the lake side. Recorded as not waterfront per default-down.
The operator page carries a second, older rate table (motorhomes/trailers $54) beneath the 2026 rates; the 2026 figure ($58) is used.
